moments.text: Infrared sensor view of patchy ground sliding past below. A tiny bright dot sits just right of the crosshair, above a small black redaction box.
Rows of long bright rectangles with dark edges pass under the crosshair; the dot stays to its right.
The dot drifts to the upper right of the crosshair as darker ground with round dark patches moves through.
The dot moves from right of the crosshair across to its upper left and stays there to the end.
